verdict.rationale: Kommo is a CRM, and self-hosting is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premise or downloadable deployment of the core product. The pack only describes a hosted SaaS with trial and pricing tiers, plus private integrations, widgets and the Web SDK, which are extensions rather than self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
